# Model evaluation and training failures

<small>Source: [`R/errors-quality.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/r-dataexcept/blob/main/R/errors-quality.R) · Help: `?model_quality_errors`</small>

Errors about a model's quality and the process that produces it: a metric
that could not be computed, cross-validation that failed, an invalid
hyperparameter, training that ran out of time, a model that fits its
training data too closely or not closely enough, a model that could not be
saved, and a computation that exceeded its resources. All inherit from
`dataexcept_data_science_error`; `training_timeout_error()` also inherits from
`dataexcept_model_training_error`, so a handler for training failures
catches it.

## Usage

```r
model_evaluation_error(
  metric,
  value,
  message = NULL,
  parent = NULL,
  call = NULL
)

cross_validation_error(folds, details = NULL, parent = NULL, call = NULL)

hyperparameter_error(param, value, message = NULL, parent = NULL, call = NULL)

training_timeout_error(model_type, timeout, parent = NULL, call = NULL)

model_serialization_error(path, parent = NULL, call = NULL)

overfitting_error(train_metric, val_metric, parent = NULL, call = NULL)

underfitting_error(train_metric, threshold, parent = NULL, call = NULL)

resource_limit_error(resource, limit, parent = NULL, call = NULL)
```

## Arguments

`metric`
:   Name of the metric.

`value`
:   For `model_evaluation_error()`, the value computed, often `NaN`.
    For `hyperparameter_error()`, the value rejected, stored as given.

`message`
:   A message to use instead of the default.

`parent`
:   The condition that caused this one, or `NULL`.

`call`
:   The call to report, or `NULL`.

`folds`
:   Number of folds.

`details`
:   Optional detail, appended to the message.

`param`
:   Name of the hyperparameter.

`model_type`
:   The model, as a name such as `"xgboost"`.

`timeout`
:   The time limit that was exceeded, in seconds.

`path`
:   The file the model was being written to. A URL is redacted.

`train_metric`
:   The metric on the training data.

`val_metric`
:   The metric on the validation data.

`threshold`
:   The smallest training metric accepted.

`resource`
:   The resource that ran out, such as `"memory"`.

`limit`
:   The limit that was exceeded, stored as given.

## Value

A condition inheriting from `dataexcept_data_science_error`.

## Examples

```r
check_fit <- function(train_auc, val_auc, tolerance = 0.1) {
  if (train_auc - val_auc > tolerance) stop(overfitting_error(train_auc, val_auc))
  invisible(TRUE)
}
tryCatch(check_fit(0.99, 0.71), dataexcept_data_science_error = conditionMessage)

# A metric that could not be computed is usually NaN.
err <- model_evaluation_error("auc", NaN)
conditionMessage(err)

# The cause of a failed save is kept, and its message appended.
saved <- tryCatch(
  saveRDS(lm(dist ~ speed, cars), file.path(tempfile(), "model.rds")),
  warning = function(w) model_serialization_error("model.rds", parent = w)
)
conditionMessage(saved)
```
